name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted bookmark manager for links, notes and images with full-text search, page archiving and optional AI tagging.

alerts.message: Sign-ups are open and the first account created becomes the administrator. Create your account right after deployment, then set DISABLE_SIGNUPS to true if the instance is private.
Automatic AI tagging and summaries need an OpenAI API key (or another provider) set in OPENAI_API_KEY. Without it, bookmarks are saved and searchable but not tagged.
